annotations.title: Domain lookup: DNS records, mail provider, SPF/DMARC, RDAP registrar, creation/expiry dates

description: Use when an agent must check a domain: does it resolve, who hosts its DNS and mail, is email authenticated, how old, when it expires. Input: domain (URLs accepted). Output: JSON DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SOA), mail provider, parsed SPF and DMARC, DNS provider, and RDAP registration (registrar, created, expires, age in days, status, DNSSEC). Failed lookups → null + dnsErrors; all failed → 503. No contact data. Use instead: site_profile for the page and security headers too; email_check for one email address. Example: ?domain=google.com Price: $0.0045 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

domain.description: Public domain or hostname (punycode for IDNs, e.g. xn--...); a URL is reduced to its hostname. Internal/reserved names → 400 (not charged)
